b01.heading: Longfu88 Bonus Terms and Rules: What to Check Before You Claim
b01.text: Longfu88 backs the first deposit with its Casino Welcome Bonus, which matches 188% of the amount, to a highest bonus of €2,088, and comes with 18 Free Spins. Wagering sits at 25x for deposit and bonus combined, and the winnings of the spins are wagered 40x separately. This page treats the Longfu bonus rules of Longfu88 in the order of an offer's life, from claiming through wagering and verification to cashing out and cashback. Written for Singapore, it covers the Longfu88 promotions, and Longfu88 limits them to players of 18 years and above.

b02.heading: Bonus Terms Explained
b02.text:
Bonus conditions rely on a few terms that return across offers. The glossary below defines each of them and, for the Casino Welcome Bonus, adds the concrete figure wherever one exists.

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Wagering requirement | Number of times a stake base must be played through before withdrawal, here 25x the deposit and bonus amount together |
| Free Spins winnings | Carry a wagering of their own, 40x the winnings, apart from the bonus amount |
| Validity | Time window for finishing the wagering, 10 days counted from activation |
| Maximum bet | Highest stake per spin permitted during wagering, set at €22.5 |
| Maximum cashout | Payout ceiling of the bonus, expressed against the initial bonus amount as 5x |
| Opt-in | Joining the Casino Weekly Cashback, whose cycle lasts four weeks |
| My Bonuses | Account area in which offers are switched on |

b03.heading: Longfu88 Welcome Bonus Rules in Short
b03.text: Qualifying first deposits at Longfu88 bring the Casino Welcome Bonus within reach, and it consists of a 188% match worth as much as €2,088, alongside 18 Free Spins, all tied to the one deposit. The deposit has to come to €50 at least, a minimum set by the bonus itself, so the match and the spins cannot be claimed apart from each other. New registered players are the audience, and each account at Longfu88 may hold only one welcome offer.

b04.heading: Claiming Without Losing Eligibility
b04.text:
Four steps lead from sign-up to completed wagering at Longfu88, and their sequence decides whether the Casino Welcome Bonus remains open to the player.

1. Registration of an account, with every required personal detail filled in.
2. A qualifying first deposit, paid in.
3. Bringing the Casino Welcome Bonus into effect through My Bonuses, prior to any wager.
4. Wagering on eligible casino games, completed before the bonus expires.

A validity of 10 days starts running once the bonus is activated, so the visit to My Bonuses precedes the first wager and the wagering has to finish within those days. Reading the four steps through before depositing, and not afterwards, is a worthwhile habit.

b05.heading: Wagering, Cashout and the Six Rules
b05.text:
This section concerns the Casino Welcome Bonus alone, as offered by Longfu88. Wagering of 25x runs on the deposit and bonus amount together, whereas Free Spins winnings are played through on a separate multiple, which leaves two targets for the player to reach.

| Condition | Figure |
|---|---|
| Wagering of the combined sum | 25 times what deposit and bonus come to together |
| Wagering of the spins' winnings | 40x |
| Validity | 10 days, starting at activation |
| Maximum bet | €22.5 for each spin |
| Maximum cashout | Payout ceiling of 5x, measured on the initial bonus amount |

Between them, the stake limit and the payout limit confine the bonus from both directions: each spin is staked at €22.5 at most during wagering, and the sum that may be withdrawn cannot rise above a fivefold of the initial bonus amount. Six more rules can cost the bonus or delay a payment, and Longfu88 lists them in this sequence:

- Deposits through Neteller or Skrill fall outside the promotion.
- Wagering requirements apply to Free Spins winnings separately.
- While one promotional bonus is running, no second one can be switched on.
- A withdrawal request that comes in advance of claiming, or while a bonus is live, may cancel the promotional eligibility.
- Unconverted promotional winnings and bonus funds are forfeited when the promotion is cancelled.
- Account verification may be a precondition of payment for promotional winnings.

Two of these rules settle before the deposit: the Neteller and Skrill exclusion and the single active bonus, so both are checked ahead of paying in. The other four matter while the bonus is open or once winnings are due.

b08.heading: Verification Before Bonus Winnings
b08.text:
Promotional winnings may be held for account verification, so a check at Longfu88 can sit between the end of the wagering and the payout. Timing matters in another respect: should a withdrawal be asked for ahead of the bonus being taken up, or while it runs, the eligibility for the promotion may then be lost.

When verification is requested, the casino asks for documents of the following kinds:

- A passport, or else photo identification issued by the authorities
- Proof that the player lives at the stated address
- Where requested, papers on the sources behind the funds or wealth of the player
- A document showing who owns the payment method

The request starts a clock of up to 30 days within which the documents can be sent. The typical review lasts up to 10 days, counting from the arrival of the full set. Given these time spans, preparing the papers before the first withdrawal request is the practical course.

b09.heading: Cashing Out After the Wagering
b09.text:
Bonus winnings become withdrawable when the wagering is finished, and a ceiling of 5x applied to the initial bonus amount limits the Casino Welcome Bonus payout. Two warnings go with this timing: requesting a withdrawal at any point before claiming, or in the active phase of the bonus, can cost the player the eligibility, and at Longfu88 a verification step can come first, ahead of the payment of promotional winnings.

Six steps make up the withdrawal:

1. Enter the cashier after logging in to the casino.
2. Pick Withdrawal, then a destination or payment method among those supported.
3. Name the amount, and provide the receiving blockchain address, wallet or bank.
4. Complete identity checks and payment-method checks if prompted.
5. Review the request, then submit it.
6. Await processing by the casino and settlement by any bank or network, after which funds arrive.

That order follows from the rules above: wagering is completed and any verification asked for is passed first, then the payout comes, since a request sent earlier puts the eligibility at risk.

b15.heading: Using Bonuses Responsibly
b15.text:
A minimum age of 18 applies to bonuses at Longfu88, and gambling must be lawful where the player is. The terms of an offer deserve reading before acceptance, namely wagering, the maximum bet and validity. On cancellation of the promotion, the player forfeits unconverted promotional winnings together with bonus funds, which is worth knowing before activation.

Responsible gambling includes the player's own habits. Self-assessment questions help identify possible harm from gambling, and answering them honestly before and during play is a sensible routine. The casino names three organisations for players who need help: Gamblers Anonymous, as well as Gambling Therapy and GamCare. Taking the time for this reading is part of using a bonus responsibly.

fixes: State only the fact: cancelling the promotion forfeits bonus funds and unconverted promotional winnings.

b16.heading: Seven Checks That Close the Rules
b16.text:
Seven points close the rules above, without rating or recommending any offer. They cover eligibility, the deposit and the state of any active bonus, and the player goes through each one at Longfu88 before a claim on the Casino Welcome Bonus is made:

- The player is newly registered, and the single welcome offer per account is still unused.
- The first qualifying deposit amounts to €50 or more.
- Neither Neteller nor Skrill is the deposit method.
- No second promotional bonus is open at the same moment.
- Activation through My Bonuses precedes every wager.
- Neither before claiming nor during the active bonus is a withdrawal requested.
- Promotional winnings may have to pass verification before payment.

b17.heading: Frequently Asked Questions on Bonus Rules
b17.text:
- **Does asking for a withdrawal early affect a bonus?** When a withdrawal is requested in advance of claiming a bonus, or during its active time, the promotional eligibility is endangered, so the request follows the completed wagering.
- **Does a bonus win bring a document check?** Verification of the account may be demanded by the casino, even ahead of the release of promotional winnings.
- **Are any deposit methods barred from the welcome bonus?** Yes, Neteller and Skrill: a deposit through either one does not earn the Casino Welcome Bonus, which makes the choice of method important before the first payment.
- **Can two bonuses run together?** No. Just one promotional bonus is allowed to be live at any moment.
- **What is the minimum age for a bonus?** The age limit is 18, and bonuses are open to players of that age or older.
- **How high can welcome bonus winnings be cashed out?** The Casino Welcome Bonus caps what can be cashed out at 5x of the initial bonus amount.
- **Where can a bonus question be sent?** The support team of Longfu88 works through live chat day and night, plus e-mail, which allows the terms of an offer to be confirmed directly with the team.
